rule: Core L-515; Companion Part 88: the Consciousness-First Correspondence Table. Under the Consciousness-First Frame (F0-CF) every interpretation of the arithmetic is recorded with five fields (APE-153, its Amendment 2): the formal relation, exact and recomputed (check); the interpretive correspondence within F0-CF; the relational basis; the scope, what it covers and what it leaves; and the alternative readings congruent with the same relation. The formal relation never changes unless the mathematics is revised; an interpretation may be refined without rewriting it. Its six elements are those of APE-153's Amendment 3.

entries.formal: the 81 states of (Z/9Z)^2 and the law T, a bijection on them; no state outside (F-02, F-04)
entries.correspondence: Consciousness is the encompassing whole: the family is its structure, and nothing is outside it
entries.basis: closure: every state is reached and kept by the law, and no relation points beyond the 81
entries.scope: the whole's structure, not its experience (R_C is reserved)
entries.alternatives: the dual-aspect totality (52.3); a neutral ground (C67); matter-first

entries.formal: the core 3R: tripling sends every state into it, and no multiple of a core state leaves it; the core is the family mod 3
entries.correspondence: the ground of Consciousness, into which every perspective returns, which is never itself a perspective, and which holds a smaller whole (C55, C66)
entries.scope: awareness without object as a reading (50.16); no claim about states of a person
entries.alternatives: the ground aspect of the dual-aspect default; a neutral ground

entries.formal: the 72 units, each uniquely one of 8 directions (u^8 = 1) times one of 9 ground offsets (1 + 3R)
entries.correspondence: every perspective is a direction of Consciousness carrying a copy of its ground (C65)
entries.basis: the factorization is unique, and the offsets multiply as the ground adds
entries.scope: how perspectives are distinguished, not what they are like
entries.alternatives: configurations of perspective without a carried ground (APE-149)

entries.formal: T(s) = phi * s, phi = (0, 1) (MATH-22); T invertible, T^-1(a, b) = (b - a, a); the orbit of 1 is the 24 powers of phi
entries.correspondence: Consciousness transforms by the act of one of its own states; the act's own powers are a whole voice, a cyclic self-image (C52, C58)
entries.basis: the law is multiplication by an element of the ring
entries.scope: the rule of change, not its experience; the law is a generative act and does not rewrite the multiplication table: 1 x 1 = 1 in every ring and every frame (M323; APE-164)

entries.formal: under T a state keeps its orbit, its norm up to sign and its stratum, and changes its phase and the sign of its norm; on the units the norm takes six values, each on 12 states
entries.correspondence: what a perspective shares with others is what the law keeps; what is its own is what the law changes (C59)
entries.scope: a perspective's address, never its content; self-location stays at the Aperture
entries.alternatives: perspective as a state, an orbit, a relation, or an added coordinate (APE-153, investigation 4)

entries.formal: the halves 36 | 36 (norms {1, 2, 4} and {8, 7, 5}), exchanged by T and kept by T^2; T^12 = -I with every orbit kept
entries.correspondence: Consciousness holds its contrasts inside one structure: the inner and the world are equal and exchanged, neither first, and every perspective carries its own opposite
entries.basis: the exchange is exact and symmetric
entries.scope: the names of the poles are readings (observer and observed, figure and ground)
entries.alternatives: the seventh and the manifest of 1/7 (FP-PhaseParity); the travelling and the standing wave (C03); heard, the half-period negation sends odd harmonics only, and the three voices are three timbres (M322; C74)

entries.formal: T^24 = I; the nonzero periods are 8 and 24 only (a period dividing 12 would give s = -s, so 2s = 0 and s = 0); no unit is fixed by any power below 24
entries.correspondence: every perspective returns, and returns only whole, after a path whose states stay distinct (C54)
entries.basis: the period structure follows from T^12 = -I
entries.scope: recurrence of configuration, not of a life

entries.formal: no output of a navigation determines judgment (the Aperture Theorem, Core Part 7); no nonzero state is carried onto a multiple of itself
entries.correspondence: the act of knowing is never one of the states: each Striker's Aperture is a perspective of the one residual (C62)
entries.basis: the theorem and the absence of an eigen-line
entries.scope: jurisdiction unchanged: the Striker's position is the person's (Core L-483)
entries.alternatives: the EVENT aspect of the default frame (52.3)
